top_story_title: Two more Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days chained in active attacks, both now in CISA KEV
top_story_summary: Ivanti has released security updates for two further Connect Secure (ICS) remote access gateway vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, that have been chained together in zero-day attacks since at least 1 October. CISA added both to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 30 October, with remediation due 2 November for CVE-2026-111357 and 13 November for CVE-2026-118527 under BOD 26-04.
top_actions: Inventory every Ivanti Connect Secure appliance, note its running build, and patch to the fixed release named in Ivanti's advisory - check the vendor advisory for the fixed release, as the sources do not state build numbers.
Run Ivanti's Integrity Checker Tool before and after the upgrade and preserve the output as evidence.
Treat the KEV deadlines as your SLA: CVE-2026-111357 was due 2 November 2026, CVE-2026-118527 is due 13 November 2026.
After upgrading, terminate all active VPN sessions and revoke session tokens - assume stolen session cookies survive the patch.
Rotate everything stored on or reachable from the appliance: local admin credentials, service accounts, LDAP/AD bind accounts, device certificates and API keys.
executive_summary: Ivanti Connect Secure: two more zero-days (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527) patched after being chained in attacks since at least 1 October; both in CISA KEV, one already past its 2 November due date.
Patch alone is not containment on ICS - kill sessions, rotate appliance credentials and certificates, and triage back to early October.

Sophos reports the Aur0ra ransomware group using AI agents, started from VPN logins, to map networks and escalate to domain admin; remote access MFA and machine-pace detection matter more than signatures.
Synology warns of a C3RB3R ransomware surge against internet-exposed NAS appliances - storage rather than network gear, but it is usually the network team's port forward that exposes it.
No new vendor AI-defence announcements in this window.
Three collected items (Windows infostealer, Linux server espionage, a caller-verification phone app) were not about network infrastructure devices and were dropped.
key_actions: **Ivanti** — Patch every ICS appliance to the fixed release named in Ivanti's advisory; do not assume a build number, confirm it against the advisory.
**Ivanti** — Run the Ivanti Integrity Checker Tool and retain the output; a clean ICT result after patching is not proof the appliance was clean before it.
**Ivanti** — Use 2026-10-01 as the earliest date for log review and forensic triage on every internet-facing ICS appliance.
**Ivanti** — Pull and preserve appliance logs, config exports and ICT output before the upgrade overwrites them.

headlines.title: Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain
headlines.summary: CISA added Ivanti Connect Secure flaws CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to KEV after both were chained in zero-day attacks on the VPN gateway.

headlines.title: Ivanti patches two more Connect Secure zero-days chained in attacks
headlines.summary: Second confirmation that Ivanti shipped fixes for two Connect Secure gateway flaws chained in zero-day attacks running since at least 1 October 2026.

headlines.title: Ransomware gang talked AI agents into doing much of its dirty work
headlines.summary: Sophos found the Aur0ra ransomware group giving AI agents VPN logins and proxy access, letting them map networks, harvest credentials and reach domain admin.

headlines.title: Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
headlines.summary: Synology told customers to update NAS appliances immediately as C3RB3R ransomware attacks against the devices surged.
